data.narrative:
Inari operates in Robotics & Manufacturing at the Series C stage, having raised $874.1M to date. The peer universe comprises nine private companies and one public comparable (277810.KQ), with leading peers including Exotec, Nimble Robotics, Agile Robots, Divergent, and Locus Robotics at comparable or adjacent funding stages.

Two valuation methods were applied. Stage-progression analysis, using the $874M raised as a proxy base and applying a 1.7x multiplier typical of Series C to next-stage advancement, yields $1.5B. Peer-median analysis across seven same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables produced a median valuation of $1.6B, with a range of $1.0B to $2.0B. The peer set includes Exotec ($2.0B, Series D), Hadrian ($1.6B, Series D), Dexterity ($1.6B, Series B), Bedrock Robotics ($1.8B, Series B), and Generalist AI ($2.0B, Series B).

Triangulating both methods produces a valuation range of $1.3B to $1.9B, with a median of $1.6B. This range reflects convergence between stage-progression and peer comparables. Key uncertainties include timing to next financing event, the ultimate deployment scale of Inari's technology, and relative operational metrics versus the peer set, which spans multiple sub-segments within robotics and manufacturing.
